summary: Shows verifying Kerberos with kinit to get a TGT, klist to list it, and on MIT Kerberos kvno to confirm a service ticket for the target (for example http/server). If kinit can't find the KDC, check DNS SRV records or krb5.conf.
questions: How do I test Kerberos from my Ansible control node?
How can I check I can get a service ticket for a Windows server?
What does it mean if kinit can't find the KDC?

answer_card.title: Verifying Kerberos works
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
kinit username@MY.DOMAIN.COM   # no output on success
klist                          # shows krbtgt/MY.DOMAIN.COM ticket
kvno http/server.my.domain.com # MIT only: get a service ticket
```

If `kinit` can't find the KDC, check DNS SRV records or the realm mapping in `krb5.conf`.
